completePactProcedure: Require CHA 13 and character 3. Preserve the original beyond-known-planes soul-pact wording as unreviewed setting provenance; this procedure grants no soul transfer, patron demands or cosmological claim. Mechanically gain the exact NEW Eldritch Blast profile and choose permanently one of three finite sigils below with the Director. This feat’s casting ability is CHA and grants rank 0 access only, not anRPpool or ranked repertoire. NEW reconcile “instead of a ranked-spell recovery” and old “instead of a spell slot” as once per real encounter substituting 2×actualrank normal HP sacrifice for the ordinary baseRPprice of one independently known/prepared rank 1–9 spell. Commit true HP loss while retaining at least 1 normal HP; temp HP, mitigation, floors/refunds cannot fund it. It is sacrifice, not damage, so no Wound/concentration/damageproc from the payment. AdditionalRPcosts, strain/armor/component surcharges, materials and action remain actual payments; final price calculation waives only original rankbase before those additions. NoRPis restored, no chargeuse bypassed, no separate ranked grant and no incidental resource output. Interrupted spell keeps all costs/use spent.

Once SR/LR use BA to mark one perceived hostile within 30 ft/lineofeffect until your next future regular start.
